meaning: Actual daily orbital centroid/area rolling-origin backtest; circle IoU is an equivalent-area proxy, not observed polygon IoU.
limitations: Daily mosaics stitch multiple swaths; not instantaneous observations.
Identity assignment and boundary confidence are subjective.
Daily regional storms are not second-scale local vortex tracks.
Testing is conditional on a member remaining identifiable; genesis, disappearance and splits are not predicted.
Error bounds are training residual quantiles, not guaranteed probabilities.
exampleSelection: Two observed MY31 tracks nearest Jezero, plus eight longest MY31-32 tracks; illustrative selection, all test metrics unchanged.
